verdict.rationale: Egnyte's own llms.txt documentation states that any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT and others) can query Egnyte content natively. That indicates a first-party MCP integration agents can connect to. Missing for 10: explicit naming of an official MCP server, setup and authentication docs, the list of exposed tools and capabilities (e.g., write actions vs. query only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: enables any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and others) to query Egnyte content natively
